endorsements.name: Alex Radocea
endorsements.label: Intercepting iCloud Keychain
endorsements.description: iCloud Keychain employs end-to-end encryption to synchronise secrets across devices enrolled in iCloud. We discovered a critical cryptographic implementation flaw which would have allowed sophisticated attackers with privileged access to iCloud communications to man-in-the-middle iCloud Keychain Sync and gain plaintext access to iCloud Keychain secrets.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2017

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
